content: Do I need to lift heavy to build muscle?

No, you don't have to lift heavy. Muscle growth is similar across a wide rep range, roughly 5 to 30 reps, as long as your sets finish close to failure (about 0 to 3 reps left in the tank). Heavier loads in the 5 to 10 rep range are more time-efficient, and lighter sets take more reps to get the same effect.

💡 For your 100 kg bench goal, you do need heavy work. Strength is specific, so keep your main bench sets in the 3 to 8 rep range. Use lighter, higher-rep accessories to add muscle volume. Ain't nothin' but a peanut!
